'''Bamfurd''' was an [[Ankura/Legends|Ankura]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] living in [[Bartyn's Landing]] as of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. Bamfurd owned and operated the business [[Bamfurd's Tapcafe]] and was the personal waiter of any customer, particularly the new ones.
